Why Param Gyan Niketan


We, at Param Gyan Niketan, are creating a space for positive conglomeration of these energies for the highest growth of human potential, the confluence and its harmony to bring about optimum nurturance for the child in this environment. In all humility, we represents this winning harmony

Main Features

Computer Lab

Our focus in technology is to introduce them to computers. We warm up each class with holding our hands in the home position on our keyboard

Library

We have tried our best to equip our library with the latest publications. The library has a large number of reference book & other instructive materials.

Transport

A fleet of modern buses is available for school transport, No request for diversion of charge in the existing routes or creation of new stops will be entertained.

Laboratory

The institution has well-equipped laboratories each for physics, chemistry and biology. Each Laboratory has been put under the charge of a demonstrator.
